title: zone-north-1 cache servers unresponsive
description: Redis cache cluster in zone-north-1 became unresponsive at 09:45 UTC. All cache reads are failing, causing application servers to fall back to direct database queries. Response times have increased 10x.

title: Search indexer failing in zone-north-1
description: ElasticSearch indexer in zone-north-1 stopped processing new documents at 09:48 UTC. The indexer cannot reach the primary data store. Search results are becoming stale. Affects product search and internal knowledge base.

title: Authentication service returning 503 — zone-north-1
description: The auth service in zone-north-1 is returning 503 Service Unavailable since 09:42 UTC. Users cannot log in or refresh tokens. The service depends on the zone-north-1 backing store which appears degraded.

title: Performance tuning request for zone-south-3 CDN
description: We've noticed suboptimal cache hit ratios on the zone-south-3 CDN edge nodes. Requesting a review of TTL settings and origin shield configuration. Not urgent — can be addressed in the next optimization cycle.

title: Training: new SRE team onboarding — incident response procedures
description: Three new SRE team members are joining next week. Please schedule an onboarding session covering our incident response runbooks, escalation paths, and PagerDuty integration. Preferred time: Tuesday 10:00-12:00 UTC.
